name: LPmud 1.4.1-A
english_description: A small, genuinely historical LPMud reference world -- "HMC LP-mud" (Harvey Mudd College), version 1.4.1-A, bundled with its own classic C-language LPMud driver (the mudlib content here runs under this project's own FluffOS build instead). A university-account game, not a commercial title: new characters arrive in the Endoplasmatorium ("a place where people without bodies come to get them") next to a clinic, a village green, and an elevator connecting up to the wizards' hall. The Adventurers' Guild runs a classic experience-and-gold leveling ladder with twenty title ranks, from "the utter novice" up through journeyman/master magician and sorcerer tiers to "the apprentice Wizard". Beyond the village (green, road, shore, bank, pub, church, and a general store) lies a real overworld: a ten-room forest chain, a mountain pass and peak, a giant's lair and treasure path, a sea and sea floor, and a chain of thirteen numbered planar rooms. A soul-verb social/emote command set (`smile`, etc.) and basic wizard tooling round out the toolkit. The game world is deliberately small and thin -- a real early-1990s single-author teaching project, not an omission in this port.
